question: As in May 2025, who was the Chairman of the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI)?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Santosh Kumar Yadav**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Santosh Kumar Yadav** serves as the Chairman of the **National Highways Authority of India (NHAI)**.
 
• The **NHAI** is responsible for managing the development, maintenance, and management of **national highways** in India.
 
• He is an **Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer** of the **1995 batch**, Uttar Pradesh cadre.
 
• His appointment as the Chairman aligns with India's vision to enhance its **infrastructure development** under various government schemes such as **Bharatmala Pariyojana**.
 
• Under his leadership, the NHAI focuses on constructing **sustainable and eco-friendly highways**, utilizing modern technologies.
 
• Santosh Kumar Yadav has played a significant role in ensuring the timely execution of **road infrastructure projects** to promote better connectivity across India.
 
• The **NHAI** operates under the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH), which is crucial in implementing the government's infrastructure goals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

 __
 
• Shri Alok Deepankar has not been reported to hold the position of Chairman of NHAI in **May 2025**.
 
• He is likely associated with other roles in administrative or governmental functions.

 __
 
• Vishal Chauhan is an **IAS officer**, but there is no information suggesting that he was the Chairman of NHAI in **May 2025**.
 
• He may be involved in other administrative capacities within the Indian government.
 
 
 
• **Anil Choudhary**__
 
 
• Anil Choudhary is not reported to hold the position of Chairman of NHAI as of **May 2025**.
 
• His contributions might be in other areas of governance or administration.
